product.title: A Magical Evening in Paris With Locals: PRIVATE City Walking Tour

description.text: See Paris at night on a personalized walking tour with a private local host who shows you the City of Light's illuminated sights. You'll stroll past the Champs Élysées, catch sight of the twinkling Eiffel Tower, and walk with your guide to Place Vendôme, Place de la Concorde, Grand Palais, and Pont Alexandre III before finishing at Trocadéro. Stops include Place Vendôme, Place de la Concorde, Champs-Elysees, Pont Alexandre III, Trocadéro, Eiffel Tower. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Paris landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Place Vendôme, Place de la Concorde, Champs-Elysees, Pont Alexandre III that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
